title: Picturesque Maze Canonical Representation
description: A width x height maze whose walls lie on cell edges; no grid lines are printed. The outer border is a wall everywhere except the entrance and exit openings. The shortest route from entrance to exit, shaded, forms a picture.

opening.description: An opening in the outer border: side of the board and the column (top/bottom) or row (left/right) of the border cell it opens.

h.description: (height - 1) x width. 1 = a wall between cell (r, c) and (r+1, c).

v.description: height x (width - 1). 1 = a wall between cell (r, c) and (r, c+1).
